objective: purchase gain against same-budget random targeting
amendment: Following explicit user instruction to continue effect improvement, extend previous stage with the already-reviewed anonymous randomized-promotion dataset. Purchase objective retained; behavioral cycle/trend hypotheses remain untested. No third alternative dataset added.

design.randomization: supported by official exercise; balanced allocation e=0.5 assumed, not inferred as fact from observed sample share
design.pre_treatment: HBS working paper Appendix F supports V1-V7 pretreatment status; actual semantics unavailable
design.release_selection: not independently audited at enterprise level; analysis conditional on official exercise RCT interpretation and released cohort
design.outcome_window: exercise purchase outcome; exact calendar duration unavailable
design.interpretation: released randomized exercise cohort; no company realized ROI or deployment claim

data_exposure: Previously read official descriptions and external paper aggregate sample rates; never accessed this project's raw Starbucks train/test data before this protocol. Search snippets exposed other published project summary performance, not thresholds or label-level data.

split.holdout: Preserve official Test.csv entirely, do not open labels until selection freeze. Only ID for disjointness before final evaluation.
split.development: Official training.csv; split 75/25 fitting/validation stratified by T x Y
split.reason: preserve original external holdout rather than mix train/test to force arbitrary 50/20/30

references.purchase: single fixed HGB trained on treated customers to predict promoted purchase propensity; same HGB limits as nuisance
references.simple: single split direct budget-value tree; no claimed RFM or field semantics

policy_tree: For each candidate partition optimize exact quota over leaf means of cross-fitted DR scores; choose split by quota utility, not squared-error loss; rank leaves, ID-hash boundary ties. Greedy local partition search, not global optimal policytree library.

selection.criterion: highest independent validation paired AIPW gain vs random at 10%; choose among 6 candidates and fixed purchase reference; numeric ties within 1e-10 prefer simpler depth1 then purchase then fewer interactions
selection.null: if no validation gain>0 select randomized policy and report no approved personalization
selection.after_selection: refit frozen winning spec and references on all official training, freeze predictions/hash before reading Test outcomes

primary_inference: paired exact-quota reranking nonparametric bootstrap, 2000 draws seed20261016; primary selected strategy-vs-random 95% percentile interval; direct Hajek and HT as robustness checks
secondary_inference: selected-vs-simple and selected-vs-purchase on same observations, Holm p and Bonferroni 97.5% intervals for these 2 contrasts; 5/20% budgets sensitivity, not replacement
sensitivity: e=0.45,0.50,0.55 and data-adaptive treatment fraction robust check, unadjusted sensitivity labels; no external causal guarantee under outcome-dependent unknown release
diagnostics: development arm events, prespecified univariate categorical effects and continuous quintiles, out-of-sample loss/calibration, feature importance descriptive, train perturbation stability later; no test-guided redesign
artifacts: new isolated report directory, all first results retained, no public data re-upload, no production changes
limits: A positive CI supports released exercise under assumptions. Not proof of cycle/trend mechanism or Starbucks real profit. No guarantee specialized uplift beats ordinary purchase prediction.
